The skill bundle provides instructions for an AI agent to interact with the CellCog service for multi-modal data analysis. The `SKILL.md` file details API usage, authentication, and examples of passing local files (e.g., PDFs, spreadsheets) to the service via `<SHOW_FILE>` tags. There are no instructions for malicious execution, unauthorized data exfiltration, persistence, or prompt injection attempts against the agent. All external interactions are directed to the legitimate `cellcog.ai` domain, consistent with the skill's stated purpose.
